---
title: "final panel"
editor: visual
---


```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false # keeps rendered Quarto less noisy

library(tidyverse)
library(mosaic)
library(skimr)
library(ggformula)
library(sf)
library(vcd)
library(supernova)


data <- read_csv("data/introextro.csv")

```



```{r}

dataM <- data %>% 
  mutate(dept = as.factor(dept), typn = as.factor(typn))



glimpse(dataM)
view(dataM)
skim(dataM)

```

```{r}
dataM |> gf_bar(~dept, fill = ~typn, position = "dodge")
dataM |> filter(typn != 0) |> gf_bar(~ dept, fill = ~typn, position = "fill")
vcd::mosaic(~dept + typn, data = dataM) 

dataM2 <- dataM |> filter(typn != 0) |> droplevels()
mosaic::xchisq.test(dept ~ typn, data = dataM2)
```
```{r}
aov(body_mass ~ species, data = penguins) |> supernova::supernova()
aov(body_mass ~ species, data = penguins) |> supernova::pairwise(plot = TRUE)

```
